policy_text_full: Home Depot offers a 30-day price adjustment. If the price drops at Home Depot or a qualifying competitor within 30 days of purchase, Home Depot refunds the difference to original tender or store credit. Auctions, closeouts, and special orders are excluded.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 30 days of purchase, customers can request a price adjustment if Home Depot or a qualifying competitor advertises the same item at a lower price.
